turns.question: By what percentage did our ad spend grow in the week of 14 September 2026 over the week before?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ad spend growth metric, so I can't give a percentage; the closest metrics are Ad spend (EUR) (ad_spend_eur) and the week-over-week growth metrics for bookings, leads and revenue (bookings_wow_growth, leads_wow_growth, revenue_eur_wow_growth). Ad spend (EUR) was 1,500.00 EUR in the week of 14-20 September 2026 and 1,415.00 EUR in the week of 7-13 September 2026. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
